- Major update: User identification process fully automated; users are no longer asked for or shown any internal identity parameters.

- Historical report queries now only use cloud API; all local/manual report retrieval is strictly forbidden.

- Initial release of "smyx-orchid-growth-status-detection-analysis" skill.
- Detects orchid new-shoot count, flower-spike length, and root color/condition from HD images (including roots in transparent pots) using AI vision.
- Delivers a holistic growth vitality assessment (vigorous/normal/weak) and general care guidance.
- Enforces strict open-id retrieval before executing analysis or viewing history, with detailed control steps and user prompts if missing.
- Supports history report lookup with results displayed in Markdown tables containing report links.
- Designed for home orchid hobbyists, greenhouses, and horticulture studios to assist optimal repotting and feeding timing.
